name: Russell Haywards
original_name: ラッセル・ヘイワーズ
source:
The brains of the "Crimson Scorpion" organization.
He is also the head of the undead collection research. He seeks to find a good human body (regardless of life or death) for this undead soldier's research. As such he laments the roughness of Josh's work. 
He operates camps that gather research of living creatures.
There is always a short supply of material.

His teacher is a necromancer who has acquired elderly immortality.

His main weapon is magic. He can not fight using physical strength at all.
